notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that had the potential to keep the player from interacting with a main boss preventing them from progressing the story.
[*] Consuming Helm can now be sold.
[*] It's no longer possible to enter the Crescent Island lighthouse before intended.
[*] Lani's name was incorrectly displayed as Mila during a cutscene in Makaiton. Fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue in Qyne's Temple where a chest with Stamina Amulet was incorrectly displayed as Harmony Earrings. 
[*] Fixed an issue in Qynes Temple when leaving the lowest level would cause the stairs to the final area to appear without pulling the necessary lever.
[*] In the Pyramid the player is no longer able to bypass a battle to access the guarded chest.
[*] When arriving in Serpent Strand the label Anhiem was being shown. Corrected.
[*] The player may now descend the stairs of the upper floors of Ryso's Temple.
[*] The Windlord will no longer respawn when reentering its domain.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the player to interact with a detonator in Serpent Strand to get infinite Funny.
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty Settings Added
notes.content:
[b]Four enemy difficulty settings to choose from:
[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Story[/b]: For those who want to enjoy the story. Enemies are weak.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Normal[/b]: Game as intended. Fair challenge with minimal grind.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Hard[/b]: For JRPG veterans who may find the game too easy. Enemies are stronger, and some will use abilities not seen in lower difficulty settings.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Impossible[/b]: For the hardcore and those who have mastered the game. Enemies are unfair, super strong, and some will use abilities not seen in lower difficulty settings.
[/list]
[b]The difficulty setting may be changed at any Inn.[/b]

notes.title: Corrections and Minor Bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In Evendusk Cove the player can no longer jump down to a boss battle after completing it.
[*] Thana’s personal quest had the wrong title and has been corrected.
[*] Suncrest Hill fixed a visual bug which caused a duplicate of Mila to appear.
[*] Widened the path to Makait Tower to make it easier to pass around the wagon.
[*] Increased the size of the main menu window to prevent Journal text from being cut off.
[*] Improved the lightning of the final boss encounter.
[/list]

notes.title: Autosave in the Rift and more fixes
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Corrected Aria’s and Ailish’s names from showing improperly.
[*] Characters that appeared to be missing tomes (Visual bug) will have them in new games from now on.
[*] Lani’s Awkward Cheer skill no longer is described as an offensive ability.
[*] Mushroom Cave on Crescent Island had a mob that would not despawn after battle. Fixed.
[/list]

[b]The Rift[/b]

[list]
[*] Celestial Strike and its description on weapons has been corrected.
[*] Autosave will now trigger on the result of your last battle.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*]The ferryman in Suncrest village will no longer get stuck on the player after being paid.
[*]“Horse Guy” in Faidias will continue to give rides to town after completing the merchant’s quest.
[*]The Fairy Necklace will now protect against Confusion.
[/list]


[b]The Rift[/b]

[list]
[*]The Mind Ring will no longer be displayed as “ZMind Ring” when found.
[*]The Flash Dagger will no longer be displayed as the “Dank Dagger” when found.
[*]Trace could sometimes use weapons he should not be proficient with. This has been fixed.
[/list]
